beatFirstContact.text: Someone told a joke by the fire. You hear Aki laugh — a real one.
Somchai has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Aki drew Bitter Manioc in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
Aki came back with 561 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
🍽️ Someone watches another basket arrive and laughs. "We're feeding the shelves more than ourselves. Not today."
The land is getting tired. The easy food is thinning.
— DAY 99 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Bitter Manioc — named and noted.
💬 Sigrun says: "Wren again. There was food by the hollow this morning — good food. Don't ask me how I know it wasn't one of us."
Dawn. You wake rested. (+3 health, energy restored. By the fire. Good enough.)
